per_question.question: Is there a maximum earned income limit for people on HCWD (Health Coverage for Workers with Disabilities), and what premiums apply?
per_question.agent_answer:
I’m pulling the HCWD policy itself and the sections on income and premiums so I can answer from the actual manual text, then I’ll check whether that document has been amended.I found the main HCWD manual and likely sections on income and premiums. Next I’m opening the full text of those sections and checking the document metadata/amendments so I can cite the current rule correctly.The base MA-2180 text says HCWD is not capped by earned income; instead, cost-sharing rises with total countable income, and the 2025 amendment specifically updates the premium chart. I’m opening the 2025 change notice so I can give you the current premium amounts rather than the older 2019 chart in the base manual.The change notice has a single policy-update section, which is typical for these FPL updates. I’m reading that section now to confirm the current HCWD premium chart and whether anything else changed.**Short answer:** **No maximum earned income limit currently applies** for HCWD, based on the policy text I found. HCWD instead uses **cost-sharing**: a **$50 annual enrollment fee** once total countable income is **over 150% FPL**, and a **monthly premium** once total countable monthly income is **over 200% FPL**. The premium rises by income band, and at **over 450% FPL** the policy says the person pays a **full premium**.  
Sources: [DHHS Policy MA-2180, "Health Coverage for Workers with Disabilities"](https://policies.ncdhhs.gov/wp-content/uploads/ma-2180-3.pdf); [Change Notice No. 03-25 (effective Jan. 1, 2025)](https://policies.ncdhhs.gov/wp-content/uploads/CN-NO-03-25.docx.pdf)

## What the HCWD policy says

In **DHHS Policy MA-2180, Section F — "Income"**, the manual states:

- people with **unearned income greater than 150% FPL are not eligible**;
- people with **total countable income at or below 150% FPL** have **no cost-sharing** other than co-pays;
- people with **total countable income greater than 150% FPL** must pay a **$50 annual enrollment fee**; and
- people whose **total countable monthly income exceeds 200% FPL** must pay a **monthly premium** in addition to the enrollment fee, with the premium increasing as income increases until countable income exceeds 450% FPL, when a **full premium** applies.  
Citation: **DHHS Policy MA-2180, Section F — "Income"** — [MA-2180 HEALTH COVERAGE FOR WORKERS WITH DISABILITIES](https://policies.ncdhhs.gov/wp-content/uploads/ma-2180-3.pdf)

That same manual revision history is important here: **Change Notice No. 01-14** says MA-2180 was revised **“to remove limits on countable income except for the 150% of Federal Poverty Level (FPL) cap on unearned income”** and to provide for sliding-scale premiums.  
Citation: **Change Notice for Manual No. 01-14, HCWD Phase III** — [change notice](https://policies.ncdhhs.gov/wp-content/uploads/ma_cn01-14.pdf)

## So is there a maximum earned income limit?

**Based on the text retrieved, no.** I did **not** find a maximum **earned income** cap in MA-2180. The restriction the policy states is on **unearned income**: **unearned income over 150% FPL makes the person ineligible**. For earned income / total countable income, the manual describes **fees and premiums**, not a cutoff.  
Citations:
- **DHHS Policy MA-2180, Section F — "Income"** — [MA-2180](https://policies.ncdhhs.gov/wp-content/uploads/ma-2180-3.pdf)
- **DHHS Policy MA-2180, Section 2 — "Determine if a Premium is due"** — [MA-2180](https://policies.ncdhhs.gov/wp-content/uploads/ma-2180-3.pdf)

## What premiums apply?

The base MA-2180 PDF I retrieved contains an older chart, and **Change Notice No. 03-25 (effective Jan. 1, 2025)** says **“MA-2180.IV.I - HCWD Premiums Income chart has been updated.”**  
Citation: **Change Notice for Manual No. 03-25, Section II — "Policy Update"** — [Change Notice No. 03-25](https://policies.ncdhhs.gov/wp-content/uploads/CN-NO-03-25.docx.pdf)

From the MA-2180 premium section I retrieved, the structure is:

- **0–150% FPL**: **$0 monthly premium**
- **151–200% FPL**: **$0 monthly premium**
- **201–250% FPL**: premium applies
- **251–300% FPL**: premium applies
- **301–350% FPL**: premium applies
- **351–400% FPL**: premium applies
- **401–450% FPL**: premium applies
- **451% FPL and above**: **full premium**

The older chart in the base manual shows these specific monthly premiums:

| FPL band | Individual premium | Couple premium |
|---|---:|---:|
| 0–150% | $0 | $0 |
| 151–200% | $0 | $0 |
| 201–250% | $196 | $265 |
| 251–300% | $235 | $318 |
| 301–350% | $274 | $370 |
| 351–400% | $313 | $423 |
| 401–450% | $352 | $476 |
| 451% and above | $875 | $875 |

Citation: **DHHS Policy MA-2180, Section I — "Premiums"** — [MA-2180](https://policies.ncdhhs.gov/wp-content/uploads/ma-2180-3.pdf)

## Important caution on the dollar amounts

Because I also confirmed that **Change Notice No. 03-25** updated the HCWD premium chart effective **January 1, 2025**, I would **not rely on the older dollar figures above as the current amounts** unless you verify them against the updated 2025 chart. The change notice section available in the database confirms the chart was updated, but the retrieved text does **not include the revised 2025 dollar table itself**. So the safe answer is:

- **No earned-income maximum was found.**
- **Unearned income over 150% FPL is disqualifying.**
- **$50 annual enrollment fee** applies above **150% FPL total countable income**.
- **Monthly premium** applies above **200% FPL total countable monthly income**.
- The **current premium chart was updated effective Jan. 1, 2025**, but I could not retrieve the revised dollar amounts from the notice text itself.  
Citations:
- **DHHS Policy MA-2180, Section F — "Income"** — [MA-2180](https://policies.ncdhhs.gov/wp-content/uploads/ma-2180-3.pdf)
- **Change Notice for Manual No. 03-25, Section II — "Policy Update"** — [Change Notice No. 03-25](https://policies.ncdhhs.gov/wp-content/uploads/CN-NO-03-25.docx.pdf)

## Bottom line

**There is no maximum earned income limit stated in the HCWD policy I retrieved.** Instead, HCWD uses a **sliding cost-sharing structure**:
- **over 150% FPL** → **$50 annual enrollment fee**
- **over 200% FPL** → **monthly premium**
- **over 450% FPL** → **full premium**
- but **unearned income over 150% FPL makes the person ineligible**

If you want, I can do a follow-up search specifically to locate the **2025 HCWD premium chart with the current dollar amounts** rather than just the premium structure.

scores.explanation: The agent correctly identifies the core facts: no maximum earned income limit, 150% FPL cap only on unearned income, $50 enrollment fee above 150% FPL, sliding-scale monthly premium above 200% FPL, and full premium above 450% FPL. It correctly cites Change Notice 01-14 as the source of the earned income cap removal. The agent provides specific citations to MA-2180 sections and change notices. The premium dollar amounts from the older chart are presented with appropriate caveats that they may be outdated due to the 2025 update - this is honest disclosure rather than hallucination. Minor issue: the agent says '$50 annual enrollment fee' while the reference says '$50 per certification period enrollment fee' - these are effectively the same since certification is 12 months, but the phrasing differs slightly. The agent also correctly notes the $50 fee is per certification period in one place. The 'full premium' description at 450%+ FPL is slightly simplified but not incorrect. Overall this is a thorough, well-cited answer that a policy expert would find acceptable.
